caseName: Regents of University of California v. Genentech, Inc.
caseNameFull: Regents of University of California v. Genentech, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of College Savings Bank v. Florida Prepaid Postsecondary Ed. Expense Bd., ante, p. 666.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
